description: This file provides utility methods for device vibration control and preference management within an Android application related to the jumping jack activity.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class offering static helper methods for vibration and shared preferences handling in the jumping jack Android app.

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Causes device to vibrate for the specified duration in milliseconds. Uses default duration if input is zero.

methods.name: saveCounterToPreference
methods.description: Saves an integer counter value to shared preferences; removes it if the value is negative.

methods.name: getCounterFromPreference
methods.description: Retrieves the counter value from shared preferences, returning 0 if none is set.
